name: Post-Alpha 0.75C-1 - Prop / Building Depth Interleave
playerPromise: Allowed props respect building massing at detail zoom: props behind buildings draw behind them, and props in front remain visible.
engineeringPromise: Buildings and props render through one shared Pixi depth stack keyed by existing iso depth helpers, while buildingLayer and propLayer remain QA-visible handles.
contract: Building and prop visual groups parent into buildingPropDepthLayer.
Building depth key is x + y + max(width, depth) * 0.001.
Prop depth key is anchor x + y.
Equal-depth ties draw buildings before props.
buildingLayer and propLayer remain discoverable from window.__ATLAS_QA__.world.children and hide their matching groups independently.
Hover and selection remain focusLayer-only and do not rebuild the base scene.

coreDepthOrderProof.assertion: prop behind building sorts earlier; prop at equal depth sorts after building; prop in front sorts later
